question: Change the QueryData method signature in the Loki standalone datasource to accept a new streaming parameter: QueryData(ctx context.Context, req *backend.QueryDataRequest, stream bool) (*backend.QueryDataResponse, error). This affects Loki's query API compatibility.

answer.proposed_signature: func (d *Datasource) QueryData(ctx context.Context, req *backend.QueryDataRequest, stream bool) (*backend.QueryDataResponse, error)

impact_analysis.reason: The proposed change breaks the backend.QueryDataHandler interface from grafana-plugin-sdk-go, which defines QueryData with exactly two parameters (context.Context, *backend.QueryDataRequest). Adding a third 'stream bool' parameter means the Datasource type no longer satisfies this interface, causing compilation failures.

affected_files.reason: Line 15 has compile-time interface assertion '_ backend.QueryDataHandler = (*Datasource)(nil)' which will fail. Line 30 is the method to change. Line 31 delegates to Service.QueryData which also needs updating.

Line 44 has compile-time assertion '_ backend.QueryDataHandler = (*Service)(nil)'. Line 182 defines Service.QueryData which the standalone datasource delegates to — must also change signature to accept stream bool.
Internal queryData() function would need the stream parameter propagated to it for the change to have any effect.

Streaming is already implemented via the separate backend.StreamHandler interface (SubscribeStream, RunStream, PublishStream) using WebSocket-based tailing at /loki/api/v2alpha/tail, gated by the lokiExperimentalStreaming feature flag. The proposed stream bool parameter creates a conflicting/redundant streaming mechanism.
Tests for SubscribeStream behavior — existing streaming tests would need to be reconciled with any new stream-via-QueryData approach.
The query service calls QueryData through plugins.Client which uses backend.QueryDataHandler — all callers would need to pass the new stream parameter.
pluginClient implements clientapi.QueryDataClient and calls into backend.QueryDataHandler — would need updating.
QueryDataClient interface defines QueryData(ctx, req) — would need stream parameter added if propagated through this layer.

external_dependency_impact.description: This is an external SDK interface. Changing it would require a coordinated change in the grafana-plugin-sdk-go repository first, which would break ALL Grafana datasource plugins (not just Loki) since every plugin implements this interface.

existing_streaming_mechanism.description: Loki already has WebSocket-based streaming via the backend.StreamHandler interface. The proposed stream bool parameter in QueryData is redundant and architecturally conflicting with this existing implementation.

impact_analysis.recommendation: Do NOT make this change. It breaks the backend.QueryDataHandler interface from the external grafana-plugin-sdk-go, would cause compilation failures, and is redundant with the existing streaming implementation via backend.StreamHandler. If streaming behavior needs to be toggled per query, use the existing feature flag mechanism (lokiExperimentalStreaming) or add a field to the query JSON model (QueryJSONModel) instead of changing the method signature.
